annotations.text:
DOT-MATRIX HERO BACKGROUND

Presence model: nothing until a track plays, then a dot spectrum fades up from the bottom edge and settles back to nothing on stop.

COLOUR — no rainbow. Each song plays inside ONE scheme: a single colour family, tone shifting across the columns and up each dot (deep foot → bright tip), plus a small in-family shimmer. The next record moves to the next scheme.

Six schemes so far — see "The scheme set" board below. Flip Main / Mobile through them with the Scheme chip; the Deck chip toggles play / idle.

Dark theme only — Studio Paper next.

IDLE — before play

Just the hero: name, tagline, crate prompt, parked deck. No matrix, no motion — the "genuinely blank" state the skyline holds when nothing plays. Most of the visit is spent here.

PLAYING — one scheme

• Fades + rises in over ~0.7s on play, settles out on stop.
• 64 columns rising from the bottom edge only; clean above.
• Colour stays in ONE family per song (here: Cobalt — teal-blue through indigo to blue-violet). Tone varies column to column and up each dot; a ±20° shimmer keeps it alive without leaving the family.
• The deck label + "now playing" dot pick up the scheme's mid tone.
• Scheme chip: Cobalt · Amethyst · Ember · Rose · Citrine · Fern.
• Copy still gets its knock-back mask (dark vignette).

MOBILE — one screen

Same reveal, coarser pitch (~15px, 24 columns), hero stacked and centred. Shown on the Fern scheme.

STILL PENDING (code, your call): the hero is `.home { height: 100vh }` in main.scss — on phones `100vh` is the tall viewport, so the section overflows the visible screen and the next one peeks as you swipe. Every other section already uses the dual `100vh` / `100svh` declaration (svh over dvh, 2026-09-02, B74). Bringing `.home` in line + checking the snap step in smooth-scroll.jsx is the fix. Say the word.
The six starting directions, kept for reference. "Groove Rings" keeps its name; the rest are as first drawn. The chosen direction lives on the Dot-Matrix page.
